Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with an indication for chronic kidney disease. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication and LEFT JOIN compound_structures for canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
